verdict.rationale: Dagster ships a well-documented Python SDK (`dagster`/`dg` CLI, asset/job/schedule APIs) plus AI-specific tooling — a dedicated AI skill for coding agents and an official MCP server — and runtime probes confirm the SDK/CLI actually installs and scaffolds/runs projects keylessly end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK ergonomics for AI agents specifically, and no documented OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found only 404s) to complement the Python SDK.
